name: Manatsu no Tobira ~Kimi to Tsuzuru Monogatari~
original_name: 真夏の扉～君と綴る物語～
source:
You play as a character asked by his sick sister to share with her a picture book that he made. Inevitably, this leads to romantic entanglements with a group of young girls, including Yukina Sakura, Yun Kitami, Nanami Mizuhara, Kaori Kashima, and Mayuko Hatuse. 

[taken from [url=http://uk.ps2.ign.com/objects/663/663429.html]IGN.com[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演的主人公受生病的妹妹所托，要和她一起阅读自己创作的绘本。这件事不可避免地令他与一群年轻女孩陷入情感纠葛，其中包括樱雪奈、北见由恩、水原七海、鹿岛香织与初濑真由子。

[引自[url=http://uk.ps2.ign.com/objects/663/663429.html]IGN.com[/url]]
